acceptanceCriteria: a conformance vector in conformance/test-validity-v0/route-stubs.json covers a stub removed by unroute before any hit, with the chosen outcome
the LPCV-V0 spec row states the unroute rule
body: Residual from the V1-1458 lane (PR #957, 2026-10-16). internal/jstestprovider/route-stubs.cjs counts hits per page.route/context.route registration; a stub the test deliberately removes with page.unroute/context.unroute before any matching request is still reported as stub-never-matched for a passing test. Expected: an unrouted stub is either excluded or reported with its removal recorded, so a deliberate removal is not a validity finding. Reported by the lane, not yet reproduced by a vector.
